result.summary: The page appears to be visually well-structured with no critical or major broken elements. There is one minor content issue regarding duplicate listings.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section displays two identical cards for 'Green Bowl Poké' with the same image, delivery time, and delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Check the backend data source to ensure unique restaurant listings are returned, or differentiate the cards if they represent different branches or menu items.
